entries.easy_read:
I need help.
I ask politely.

entries.text: Could you show me once more?
entries.easy_read:
Please show me again.
Then I will know.

entries.text: I need help with this machine.
entries.easy_read:
The machine is hard for me.
I need help.

entries.text: Who can help me with this?
entries.easy_read:
I do not know who to ask.
I ask who can help.

entries.text: I am not sure how to do this. Could you guide me?
entries.easy_read:
I do not know how.
Please teach me.

entries.text: This is too heavy for me. Could someone give me a hand?
entries.easy_read:
This box is very heavy.
I need someone to help me lift it.

entries.text: When you are free, could you check my work?
entries.easy_read:
You are busy now.
Please look at my work later.

entries.text: Sorry to bother you. Do you have a minute?
entries.easy_read:
I say sorry for stopping you.
I ask for a little time.

entries.text: I cannot reach that shelf. Could you pass it to me?
entries.easy_read:
The shelf is too high.
Please give it to me.

entries.text: Could you read this out for me, please?
entries.easy_read:
I want to know what it says.
Please read it to me.

entries.text: Could you help me fill in this form?
entries.easy_read:
This form is hard.
Please help me write it.

entries.text: I am stuck. Could you look at this with me?
entries.easy_read:
I cannot go on.
Please look with me.

entries.text: Thank you for helping me. That is much clearer now.
entries.easy_read:
You helped me.
I say thank you.
Now I understand.

entries.text: May I ask my supervisor about this?
entries.easy_read:
I want to ask my boss.
I ask if that is okay.

entries.text: I would like more training on this task.
entries.easy_read:
I want to learn more.
Please teach me this job.

entries.text: Could someone work with me the first few times?
entries.easy_read:
This is new for me.
Please let someone work with me.
After that I can work alone.
